profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Procore Technologies
profile.summary: As a Software Engineer, I am responsible for working directly with Product Managers, UX Desginers, and Quality Assurance Engineers to deliver high-quality software at speed.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Researching, comparing, and presenting options, such as PDF rendering services, to determine which is the best solution for the company based on cost, support, etc.
Migrating legacy Ruby on Rails views to standalone Node/React microservices
Architecting long term coding solutions that are backwards compatible with existing data structures and other clients, such as SVG document markup data objects
Enhancing the perceived performance for large data tables or large documents loading
Building reusable React components with ease of use API that can be utilized across microservices
Benchmarking load times, reducing number of re-renders, and mindfully caching data to improve application performance
Collaborating with front end members to improve build, test, publish, and deploy times for local development and CircleCI workflows
Pairing with team members to design and agree on REST API contracts
Breaking apart user stories into more manageable tasks to deliver features efficiently and safely

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Developed automated front-end integration feature tests to help replace laborious manual testing.
Created automated smoke test plans for running regularly to prevent major bugs within a monolith application.
Walked new hires through the QA Engineering process which includes introduction to automation and our code base.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
Worked directly with Product Managers and Software Engineers to deliver high-quality software at speed
Devised and executed test plans for all new code
Documented bugs and pushed for their resolution
Served as an advocate for the client during the software development process

positions.title: Full Stack Web Development Teacher Assistant
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Lead review sessions on debugging, Javascript, and React to assist students on difficult topics.
Assisted students during office hours with questions on homework or in class projects.
Rotated through Zoom breakout rooms during class to help students with in class assignments.

positions.title: Venture Incubation Coordinator
positions.description:
Managed University owned businesses' fiscal analysis.
Lead the Venture Branch Weekly Meetings with a set agenda.
Contacted other establishments for research, possible discounts, potential partnerships,etc.
Created detailed models from venture ideas, which turned into a written proposal for Senate to approve of.
Designed and planned for necessary forms.
Attended the Senate Meetings and Finance Board Meetings to hear bills pass.
Headed the University's iClicker Rental Program
Assisted other team members with research and execution of projects.

company.name: UCSB AS Office of the Controller

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Developed and maintained cross-marketing promotions for Fitness Partners.
Constructed various digital advertisement designs.
Actively searched for organizations who would like hold fundraisers at our store.
Worked on the floor in the front of the house which includes jobs such as: cashier, dish busser, and server.
Assisted with large catering events.

positions.title: Hostess
positions.description:
Guided clients to planned, open tables.
Aided waiters and waitresses during rush hours.

volunteerExperiences.description:
As President of Sheldon High School's Key Club International, I had the responsibility to discover and organize volunteer opportunities. I lead weekly meetings to inform fellow members of these volunteer events and coordinated ride shares and scheduling.

I also focused on fundraising money for the club so that about 200 members could attend the Key Club International Leadership conferences at a discounted price.

I helped organize VC Innovates first mini Hackathon by the Sea event specifically marketed to 7-12th grade girls. Hackathon by the Sea is a coding event in which teams “hack” together an awesome project like a game, website, or app. Our goal was to encourage and empower teenage girls to join the full Hackathon by the Sea event in Decemenber.

During the event, I became a mentor to a few teams and was able to guide those who had zero coding experience. These teams were able to walk away with a self-built project, newfound knowledge in software development, and the courage to continue pursing their passion in technology.

I am continuing to volunteer as an organizer and mentor for the next annual Hackathon by the Sea event. 

https://www.hackathonbythesea.com/
